evaluation_scope: One approved synthetic UltraVox hosted API smoke test. The test creates an agent-first server-WebSocket call, listens for first audio bytes, closes the socket, and deletes the call.

provider.voice_selection_rule: Optional. If the env var is blank, omit voice and let UltraVox use its default voice. If set, the value must be a public included voice ID or unique voice name.

synthetic_case.customer_transcript: Synthetic setup only. No customer audio is sent in this smoke test.
synthetic_case.agent_first_text: This is a synthetic UltraVox smoke test for the local sales-agent project. No customer audio is being used.
synthetic_case.system_prompt: You are running a single synthetic provider smoke test for a local guarded sales-agent project. Say only the provided test sentence. Do not ask follow-up questions, do not sell anything, do not collect personal data, do not mention real customers, and end the test after the short sentence.
success_criteria: create call succeeds with env-only API key
joinUrl is received but not logged
first audio bytes are received or a provider error is captured
call delete is attempted after the test
